mapper.select: SELECT t_price_bidding.id, t_price_bidding.tender_number AS tenderNumber, t_price_bidding.customer AS customer, t_price_bidding.latest_quotation AS latestQuotation, t_price_bidding.quantity AS quantity, t_price_bidding.quotation_time AS quotationTime, t_price_bidding.win_bid_status AS winBidStatus FROM t_price_bidding LEFT JOIN t_sales_bidding ON t_price_bidding.tender_number = t_sales_bidding.tender_number WHERE t_price_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_price_bidding.latest_quotation != '0' AND t_price_bidding.quantity != '0' AND t_price_bidding.tender_number =#{tenderNumber} AND t_price_bidding.win_bid_status ='已中标' ORDER BY t_price_bidding.gmt_create ASC

SELECT t_process_operation.technological_process AS technologicalProcess, t_process_operation.operator_name AS operatorName, t_process_operation.operator_time AS operatorTime, t_process_operation.operation AS operation FROM t_process_operation WHERE t_process_operation.is_deleted = 0 AND t_process_operation.order_number = #{biddingNo}
SELECT count(t_price_bidding.customer) FROM t_price_bidding WHERE t_price_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_price_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber} AND t_price_bidding.win_bid_status = '已中标'
SELECT t_apply_bidding.customer FROM t_apply_bidding WHERE t_apply_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_apply_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber} GROUP BY t_apply_bidding.customer

SELECT t_price_bidding.customer AS customer, t_price_bidding.quantity AS transactionQuantity FROM t_price_bidding WHERE t_price_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_price_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber} AND t_price_bidding.win_bid_status = '已中标'

SELECT t_price_bidding.latest_quotation AS transactionPrice, t_price_bidding.quantity AS transactionQuantity, t_price_bidding.quotation_time AS quotationTime FROM t_price_bidding WHERE t_price_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_price_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber} AND t_price_bidding.win_bid_status = '已中标'

SELECT t_apply_bidding.id, t_sales_bidding.bidding_no AS biddingNo, t_apply_bidding.customer AS customer, t_apply_bidding.regional_name AS regionalName, t_sales_bidding.brand_name AS brandName, t_apply_bidding.latest_quotation AS latestQuotation, t_apply_bidding.transaction_price AS transactionPrice, t_apply_bidding.quantity AS quantity, t_apply_bidding.transaction_quantity AS transactionQuantity, t_sales_bidding.delivery_warehouse AS deliveryWarehouse, t_apply_bidding.quotation_time AS quotationTime, t_sales_bidding.delivery_Method AS deliveryMethod, t_sales_bidding.shipping_type AS shippingType, t_sales_bidding.payment_method AS paymentMethod FROM t_apply_bidding LEFT JOIN t_sales_bidding ON t_apply_bidding.tender_number = t_sales_bidding.tender_number WHERE t_apply_bidding.is_deleted = 0 AND t_sales_bidding.is_deleted = 0 AND t_apply_bidding.win_bid_status = '已中标' AND t_sales_bidding.order_bidding_no = 1 AND t_apply_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber}
mapper.insert:

mapper.select: select t_system_org.org_no from t_system_user join t_system_user_org on t_system_user_org.user_id = t_system_user.id join t_system_org on t_system_org.id = t_system_user_org.org_id where t_system_user_org.display_status = '1' and t_system_user.user_name = #{userName}
